Mia (CSM): Heads-up, Forklift onboarding hit a spend surge during last 48h. QBR Wed — need a 2-slide summary: root cause, mitigations, owners. Link: https://redwood.internal/forklift-onboard

Omar (AM): Confirmed. Top is embeddings + high-frequency similarity checks. Pulling per-route tokens now.

cost-bot: ALERT: Forklift projected +25% over commit in 6d. Top contributors: embeddings 58%, rerank 25%.

Sasha (FinOps): Please run the 14d token query and paste numbers. I'll run dollar projection once we have tokens.

Mia (CSM): Quick customer-facing bullets needed: what we changed (immediate), recommended next steps, who presents.

Leo (Solutions Eng): Quick experiment I can run: enable per-account prefix KV cache, set embedding_batch_limit=200, and route non-critical jobs to quantized model. Command (staging):
curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/forklift/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"kv_cache":true,"embedding_batch_limit":200,"route_policy":"cost-aware"}'
I'll share token delta after 2h test.

Omar (AM): Draft bullets for QBR:
1) Immediate: throttle ingestion to 500 TPS and enable KV cache (owners: Omar/Leo)
2) Short-term: add budget webhook at 70% and weekly spend digest (owner: Sasha)
3) Next: 60-min enablement session on prompt shaping + dedupe (owner: Mia)

Sasha (FinOps): I'll add projected savings for quantized fallback (~30%) and attach to slide once Omar posts counts.

Mia (CSM): Omar will present cost slide. I'll create ticket and add owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

cost-bot: TICKET #CS-9501 created: 'Forklift onboarding spend triage' (owner: Omar)
